description: This file implements logging functionalities for the Rialto project, including log level management, log handlers for different output methods (file, journald, console), and utility functions for logging messages with various severity levels and context information.

methods.name: componentToString
methods.description: Converts a RIALTO_COMPONENT enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: levelToString
methods.description: Converts a RIALTO_DEBUG_LEVEL enum value to its string abbreviation.

methods.name: fdLogHandler
methods.description: Handles logging messages by writing them to a file descriptor, formatting timestamp, level, component, thread ID, and message.

methods.name: journaldLogHandler
methods.description: Handles logging messages by sending them to systemd journal via syslog, including context information.

methods.name: rialtoLog
methods.description: Core logging function that formats messages, checks log levels, and dispatches to appropriate handlers.
